hooks.command:
set -- `# <#`
bash "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/hook.sh" start
exit
: <<'#PS_END'
#>
$u = New-Object System.Text.UTF8Encoding $false; [Console]::InputEncoding = $u; [Console]::OutputEncoding = $u; $OutputEncoding = $u
[Console]::In.ReadToEnd() | & (Get-Process -Id $PID).Path -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/hook.ps1" start; exit $LASTEXITCODE
#PS_END
